title: The Book of Margery Kempe: facsimile and edition (including the Wynkyn de Worde pamphlet)
author: Margery Kempe
license_note: The legal page says the images of British Library MS Add. 61823 and the transcripts of it are in the public domain under Creative Commons terms; images of the Cambridge University Library de Worde pamphlet are © Cambridge University Library. The licence of the pamphlet transcription is not stated.
notes: Only the Wynkyn de Worde pamphlet (Here begynneth a shorte treatyse of contemplacyon..., printed in Fleet Street around 1501) falls in the period: the site gives a diplomatic transcription of it, beside facsimile images, in the Showcase viewer, plus a comparison with the Book. The main text, the manuscript BL MS Add. 61823 (copied around 1440, with later annotating hands), has diplomatic and reader's editions on the site. Active: a project page was edited on 2025-04-03. The counts cover the pamphlet only, since the manuscript lies outside 1450-1700. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
